title: Man Kills Girlfriend at AutoZone After Toxic Argument
description:
Bedford, Ohio police respond to a shooting at an AutoZone parking lot where 20-year-old Riley Jones was shot by her boyfriend Darian Hobley following a toxic argument and car chase. Hobley claimed self-defense but was arrested with blood on his clothing and an illegal ghost gun ditched nearby.
